def transform(grid):

    right_bg = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] != left_bg and right[r][c] != right_bg else 8 for c in range(separator)] for r in range(len(grid))]

def transform(grid):
    separator = len(grid[0]) // 2
    left = [row[:separator] for row in grid]
    right = [row[separator + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    common = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else common for c in range(separator)] for r in range(len(grid))]
